eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.description: What you need in order to apply.

benefits.title: Benefits
benefits.description: What you get as an affiliate.

rulesItems: Only one affiliate application can be submitted per account.
An approved application is required for affiliate membership to activate.
Even after approval your account stays a customer account — only the affiliate badge and benefits are added.
Promotion must be conducted honestly and transparently.
Benefits may be removed if a breach of the rules is proven.
eligibilityItems: You must have an active RizqifyBD customer account.
The account must not be suspended or deleted.
You must agree to the programme's terms and conditions.
You should have a genuine way to promote RizqifyBD to your audience.
Benefits continue as long as you keep promoting responsibly.
benefitsItems: An affiliate badge on your profile and dashboard.
Recognition as an official RizqifyBD affiliate partner.
A clear, single application with fast review.
Fair and transparent evaluation of every application.
Support from the RizqifyBD team as the programme grows.
